record.bible_text: Behold, I will send<WH07971><WTH8802> my messenger<WH04397>, and he shall prepare<WH06437><WTH8765> the way<WH01870> before<WH06440> me: and the Lord<WH0113>, whom ye seek<WH01245><WTH8764>, shall suddenly<WH06597> come<WH0935><WTH8799> to his temple<WH01964>, even the messenger<WH04397> of the covenant<WH01285>, whom ye delight<WH02655> in: behold, he shall come<WH0935><WTH8804>, saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>.
